# API regression corpus for bin/api-diff.php
#
# One request per line. "@admin" prefixes an entry that is sent with the
# --session cookie. "#" starts a comment.
#
# The invariant these entries defend: external API responses stay byte-identical
# across the restructuring. Both URL styles are covered on purpose — the pretty
# paths (rewritten by api/v1/.htaccess) and the raw ?action=&itemType= form that
# Phase 5g's FastRoute must keep answering.
#
# Entity ids are real rows in the DE dev dataset; if the dataset is rebuilt the
# fixtures must be re-recorded.

# --- getItem, all eight entity types (pretty path) ---------------------------
/api/v1/person/Q132733606
/api/v1/organisation/Q56034
/api/v1/term/Q15081430
/api/v1/document/7726
/api/v1/media/DE-0200172058
/api/v1/session/DE-0180001
/api/v1/agendaItem/5204
/api/v1/electoralPeriod/DE-018

# --- getItem, legacy query form (must match the pretty path byte for byte) ---
/api/v1/?action=getItem&itemType=person&id=Q132733606
/api/v1/?action=getItem&itemType=organisation&id=Q56034
/api/v1/?action=getItem&itemType=media&id=DE-0200172058
/api/v1/?action=getItem&itemType=session&id=DE-0180001
/api/v1/?action=getItem&itemType=agendaItem&id=5204
/api/v1/?action=getItem&itemType=electoralPeriod&id=DE-018

# --- search, every itemType --------------------------------------------------
/api/v1/search/media?q=klima&limit=2
/api/v1/search/people?q=meier&limit=2
/api/v1/search/organisations?q=fraktion&limit=2
/api/v1/search/documents?q=gesetz&limit=2
/api/v1/search/terms?q=klima&limit=2
/api/v1/search/electoralPeriods?limit=2
/api/v1/?action=search&itemType=media&q=klima&limit=2

# --- search with filters + paging (the handler most at risk in 5a) -----------
/api/v1/search/media?q=der&personID=Q132733606&limit=2
/api/v1/search/media?q=klima&limit=2&page=2
/api/v1/search/media?dateFrom=2020-01-01&dateTo=2020-12-31&limit=2

# --- pagination links: every boundary, on a paginated set of each search type -
# The entries above all land on page 1 or return an error, so they never exercise
# prev/next. These walk real multi-page sets. Result sizes are small and the
# queries are ordered, so the page boundaries are stable.
# people name=schmidt: 14 hits, limit 5 -> 3 pages
/api/v1/search/people?name=schmidt&limit=5
/api/v1/search/people?name=schmidt&limit=5&page=2
/api/v1/search/people?name=schmidt&limit=5&page=3
# 0 hits: still a valid single empty page, prev and next both null
/api/v1/search/people?name=zzzznotfound
# organisations type=faction: 8 hits, limit 3 -> 3 pages
/api/v1/search/organisations?type=faction&limit=3&page=2
# terms label=klima: 11 hits, limit 5 -> 3 pages
/api/v1/search/terms?label=klima&limit=5
# documents: array-valued label must round-trip identically in all five links
/api/v1/search/documents?label[]=gesetz&label[]=antrag&limit=5&page=2
# electoralPeriods: single page, and pins the rebuilt self link
/api/v1/search/electoralPeriods?parliament=DE
# media fields=id path carries links; getAllResults keeps self only
/api/v1/search/media?q=klima&fields=id&limit=2
/api/v1/search/media?q=klima&sessionID=DE-0200172&fields=id&getAllResults=1
# fields=queue: the player's compact node. Sorted by date so the order does not
# ride on BM25 scores. With q it carries segments; a pure entity filter has none.
/api/v1/search/media?q=klima&limit=2&fields=queue&sort=date-asc
/api/v1/search/media?personID=Q77195&limit=2&fields=queue&sort=date-asc
# last is clamped to the largest page the search backend can serve
/api/v1/search/media?q=der&limit=2

# --- autocomplete ------------------------------------------------------------
/api/v1/autocomplete/text?q=klim
/api/v1/autocomplete/entities?q=klim
/api/v1/autocomplete/agendaItem?q=klim

# --- status ------------------------------------------------------------------
/api/v1/status?parliament=DE
/api/v1/status/all?parliament=DE
/api/v1/?action=status&itemType=all&parliament=DE

# --- content negotiation on media/session URIs -------------------------------
/api/v1/media/DE-0200172058?format=iiif
/api/v1/media/DE-0200172058?format=akomantoso
/api/v1/media/DE-0200172058?format=parlamint
/api/v1/session/DE-0180001?format=iiif
/api/v1/session/DE-0180001?format=akomantoso
/api/v1/session/DE-0180001?format=parlamint
# Explicit transcript selection exercises transcriptResolve()'s type/lang
# branches rather than its default pick.
/api/v1/media/DE-0200172058/transcript.vtt?type=proceedings&lang=de
/api/v1/media/DE-0200172058/transcript.vtt?type=nosuchtype
/api/v1/media/DE-0200172058/transcript.vtt
/api/v1/?action=transcript&itemType=vtt&id=DE-0200172058

# --- IIIF collections --------------------------------------------------------
/api/v1/iiif/collection/DE
/api/v1/iiif/collection/DE/DE-019
/api/v1/iiif/search?q=klima&limit=2
/api/v1/?action=iiif&itemType=collection&parliament=DE

# --- session-gated actions: anonymous (403) and with an admin session --------
/api/v1/statistics/general?parliament=DE
@admin /api/v1/statistics/general?parliament=DE
@admin /api/v1/statistics/entity?entityType=person&entityID=Q132733606
@admin /api/v1/statistics/word-trends?parliament=DE&word=klima
@admin /api/v1/statistics/entity-counts?parliament=DE
/api/v1/?action=getItemsFromDB&itemType=conflict
@admin /api/v1/?action=getItemsFromDB&itemType=conflict&getStats=true
@admin /api/v1/import/status?parliament=DE
@admin /api/v1/index/status?parliament=DE
@admin /api/v1/index/statistics-status?parliament=DE
# system/status reports storage from var/ — pinned so a runtime-path change shows up
@admin /api/v1/?action=system&itemType=status
/api/v1/?action=system&itemType=status

# --- notifications / alerts / system messages (public action, module-gated) --
/api/v1/alert/list
/api/v1/notification/unreadCount
/api/v1/systemMessage/list

# --- playlists (public action, module-gated; resolve is the anonymous surface) -
# Stateless entries only. A logged-in list is deliberately absent: it would pin
# whatever playlists the session user happens to own, and fail as soon as they
# make one.
/api/v1/playlist/list
/api/v1/playlist/resolve
# A well-formed token that matches nothing, and a malformed one — both 404, so a
# token cannot be used to tell "private" from "does not exist".
/api/v1/playlist/resolve?token=00000000000000000000000000000000
/api/v1/playlist/resolve?token=not-a-token
@admin /api/v1/playlist/get?id=999999
/api/v1/?action=playlist&itemType=list

# --- error cases -------------------------------------------------------------
/api/v1/person/Q00000000000
/api/v1/media/NOT-A-REAL-ID
/api/v1/person/not-a-qid
/api/v1/?action=getItem&itemType=person
/api/v1/?action=getItem&id=Q132733606
/api/v1/?action=nosuchaction&itemType=person
/api/v1/?action=getItem&itemType=nosuchtype&id=Q1
/api/v1/search/media?q=klima&limit=99999
/api/v1/?itemType=person&id=Q132733606

# --- internal calls must not inherit the caller's query string (5a) ----------
# status runs two internal media searches for lastUpdated/lastSpeechDate. While
# apiV1() merged the superglobals into internal calls, any filter the client
# appended steered those searches, so this had to stay byte-identical to
# /api/v1/status?parliament=DE above.
/api/v1/status?parliament=DE&q=klima&dateTo=2015-01-01&personID=Q77195
# The faction lookups behind the filter bar and the factionColors JS map pass no
# paging params. Under the merge, ?page=3 asked for page 3 of the 8-row faction
# list and emptied both. Pins resultsPerFaction on a non-first page.
/content/components/result-grid.php?a=search&queryOnly=1&q=klima&page=3

# --- admin-only itemTypes stay admin-only ----------------------------------
# Only the anonymous 403 is pinned, not an admin row dump: entity_remap rows are
# operator-edited data, so a fixture of them would fail on every legitimate edit.
# What must not drift is that the action is refused without an admin session.
/api/v1/?action=getItemsFromDB&itemType=entityRemap

# --- entity dump ------------------------------------------------------------
# Bulk export consumed by external NEL pipelines, which parse the body verbatim.
# Served outside the JSON envelope with its own encoder flags (JSON_HEX_QUOT |
# JSON_HEX_APOS), so only a byte comparison catches drift. The legacy
# /data/entity-dump path 301s here and is pinned too.
/api/v1/entityDump/organisation
/api/v1/entityDump/term
/api/v1/entityDump?type=organisation
/data/entity-dump/?type=organisation

# --- direct-served AJAX fragments -------------------------------------------
# These are fetched by JS, not by the router, and their URLs are string-built in
# JS (`result-${view}.php`), so no static check catches a rename breaking them.
# A refactor that renames a fragment must keep these green.
/content/components/result-grid.php?a=search&queryOnly=1&paginationMode=url-driven&baseUrl=/search&showHome=1
# sort=date-asc is load-bearing: unsorted, unfiltered match_all ordering across
# 2.5M docs is shard- and segment-dependent, so an index optimize or import
# reshuffles which 40 rows come back and the fixture diffs by hundreds of lines
# for no code reason.
/content/components/result-table.php?a=search&queryOnly=1&sort=date-asc
/content/pages/media/components/player.php?id=DE-0200172058

# --- entity node builder error branches (5d) ---------------------------------
# Every getItem error path of the four parliament-scoped entities. The node
# builders in modules/entities/ signal these as exceptions and the api/v1
# wrappers translate them back, and the four entities deliberately disagree
# about which envelope each case gets — a malformed session id is a parse error
# while a malformed electoralPeriod id with a good parliament is too, an unknown
# parliament is an invalid-id error everywhere, and only media has a 511. That
# spread is frozen, so pin one request per branch.
/api/v1/media/XX-0200172058
/api/v1/media/DE-0209999999
# Non-public speech: mediaGetNode() enforces the access check for every consumer
# (transcript, export, IIIF, feeds), so this must stay a 511 and its .vtt a 404.
/api/v1/media/DE-0180001004
/api/v1/media/DE-0180001004/transcript.vtt
/api/v1/media/DE-0180001004?format=iiif
/api/v1/session/DE-020
/api/v1/session/XX-0200172
/api/v1/session/DE-0209999
/api/v1/agendaItem/XX-5204
/api/v1/agendaItem/DE-99999999
/api/v1/?action=getItem&itemType=electoralPeriod
/api/v1/electoralPeriod/XX-018
/api/v1/electoralPeriod/DE-099

# --- URL-shape edge cases the .htaccess rewrites produce (5g) ----------------
# Several rewrite rules are deliberately unanchored, so trailing junk is ignored
# rather than 404'd, and a bare action segment yields action-without-itemType.
# FastRoute is strict by default, so every one of these is a way the routing
# cutover could silently change behaviour. Recorded against the .htaccess rules.
/api/v1/person/Q77195/junk
/api/v1/search/media/extra?q=klima&limit=1
/api/v1/search
/api/v1/status/all
/api/v1/nosuchthing
/api/v1/nosuchthing/x
/api/v1/statistics/entity/person
/api/v1/entityDump/x/y
@admin /api/v1/statistics/entity/person/Q132733606
@admin /api/v1/statistics/entity/person/Q132733606/junk
